mapper.select: SELECT a.id, sys_account_role.role_id, sys_account_role.account_id, a.user_name, a.nick_name, a.mobile, a.email FROM sys_account_role LEFT JOIN sys_account a ON a.id = sys_account_role.account_id WHERE sys_account_role.role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT a.id, a.id as account_id, a.user_name, a.nick_name, a.mobile, a.email FROM sys_account a WHERE a.del_flag = 0 AND a.id not in (SELECT account_id FROM sys_account_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId})
